start.welcome:
👋 Welcome to support service!

I will help you with any questions about the game.

tickets.created:
✅ Ticket #{ticket_number} created!

Your question will be processed shortly. Average response time: 5-10 minutes.
tickets.max_reached: ❌ You already have {max} active tickets. Please wait for a response or close existing tickets.
tickets.closed:
✅ Ticket #{ticket_number} closed.

Thank you for contacting us! If you have new questions, create a new ticket.
tickets.auto_closed:
⏰ Ticket #{ticket_number} was automatically closed due to inactivity.

If you have any questions, please create a new ticket.

errors.general: ❌ An error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.permission_denied: ❌ You don't have access to this command.
errors.already_assigned: ⚠️ This ticket was already taken by another manager.
errors.unknown_command: 🤔 I don't understand this command. Please choose an action from the menu below:
errors.text_only: 📝 Please send a text message or a sticker.
errors.ticket_closed: ⚠️ This ticket is already closed. If your question is still relevant, please create a new ticket.
